## Overview

This field guide addresses causal inference and sensitivity analysis methods for science education researchers. It complements my work on the [IES-funded konfound project](../../Projects/IES_Konfound/IES_konfound.qmd), which develops tools for assessing the robustness of causal inferences.

[Read the preprint →](https://doi.org/10.31234/osf.io/kn5qb_v2)
